decisions.reason: The supplement range has its own web page, builds on the established offer and is central to the announced consumer health expansion, so management stays committed.
The joint supplement was publicly announced as new within the established Trivital line and fits the consumer health direction, so persisting is justified.
The mushroom immune supplement has little visibility, but it is a low-cost line extension and demand for immune products rose after 2020, so weak results can be read as temporary.

Despite the valsartan contamination setback and its distance from the core, the investment in the generic and generics broadening as an announced direction push management to re-source rather than exit.
The OTC triptan was given its own web page, involved regulatory investment and fits the announced OTC portfolio expansion, so management persists despite the lack of recent website evidence.
